text: I have honestly never seen a hoodie like this before. Brand Comfort just came out with a brand new collection called the Comfort Ski Club. I really hope that your size is not completely sold out by the time you're seeing this. It's almost as if this hoodie is made of snow and you're the mountain and all these little people are skiing and snowboarding down you. It is a 360 design going around the entire hoodie, even to the point where people are actually skiing and snowboarding inside of your kangaroo pouch. You have that embroidered Comfort logo right there that says Comfort Ski Club, and it is still made of that super thick, super high quality material that Comfort is known for. These are actually made to fit slightly oversized, so whatever size you normally wear in Comfort hoodies, I would go ahead and stick with that sizing. For size reference, I'm 6'3", 226 pounds. I actually went ahead and sized up to a 2X because I like my hoodies to fit more oversized and it fits incredible. Comfort went ahead and put these as part of a pretty big sale they got going on right now. The sizes are already starting to disappear, so if you wanted to go ahead and grab this brand new Comfort Ski Club hoodie, and if you wanted to go ahead and grab the matching pair of straight leg sweatpants to go with it, I would go ahead and do so now because with these being limited edition only around for the holidays, once this does sell out, it will not be coming back. And if you actually need help with your sizing, let me know your height and your weight in the comments down below, and I'll be sure to help you out.
